_comment: Season metadata for /benpixel/. The season number and Minecraft version are read from the server MOTD; maintenance is detected from the MOTD. start/end define the season window and decide whether an offline server shows 'Currently offline' (inside the window) or 'Off-Season' (outside it). discord is the invite URL for the Join button. Dates use ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). state: auto follows the live server, offline forces the off-season view, maintenance forces the maintenance view.
description: Benpixel runs in seasons. Each season opens a fresh world for a limited time, then closes and is archived before the next one begins. When the server is offline, this page switches to off-season mode automatically.

highlights.title: Seasonal worlds
highlights.body: Every season starts with a fresh world and a clean slate.

highlights.title: Vanilla-first
highlights.body: Lightweight quality-of-life adjustments. No pay-to-win, no clutter.

highlights.title: Archived history
highlights.body: Season worlds are archived when they close, so nothing is lost.

history.title: First Deployment
history.body: The first server ran on G-Portal shared hosting, then moved to a self-managed PaperMC build on a local Windows machine for faster iteration.

history.title: Hypervisor Leap
history.body: A headless Proxmox VE setup replaced the single Windows host, separating the game server into isolated Linux VMs.

history.title: Enterprise Node
history.body: Consumer hardware gave way to an enterprise Supermicro Xeon node, with JVM and garbage-collection tuning for stable throughput.

history.title: Datacenter Migration
history.body: The server moved to co-located infrastructure in the Netherlands on a dedicated Ryzen 7 7700X node for stronger single-thread performance.

history.title: Benpixel Revolutions
history.body: The current chapter: a seasonal server with a live status page, a rules agreement, and a whitelist request flow. Built to reset, return, and improve every season.

whitelist.message: Whitelist requests open with the next season.
